rainbowBrackets.roundBracketsColor.markdownDescription: Colors of round brackets `()`, one for each level of nesting, repeating after the last one.

rainbowBrackets.squareBracketsColor.markdownDescription: Colors of square brackets `[]`, one for each level of nesting, repeating after the last one.

rainbowBrackets.squigglyBracketsColor.markdownDescription: Colors of squiggly brackets `{}`, one for each level of nesting, repeating after the last one. Unless this is set, the first color is `#484c61` in light themes and `#d4d4aa` in dark themes.

rainbowBrackets.isolatedRightBracketsCol.markdownDescription: Color of closing brackets that have no opening bracket.

rainbowBrackets.excludedLanguageIds.markdownDescription: [Language identifiers](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/languages/identifiers#_known-language-identifiers) of the files to leave uncolored. E.g. `markdown`

rainbowBrackets.ignoreStringsAndComments.markdownDescription: Leave brackets in strings, comments and regular expressions uncolored, as the syntax highlighting of the language shows them. Brackets are colored everywhere in languages without syntax highlighting.
